changes: Shop standard provider discovery now imports the exact approved SDK, eliminating duplicate discovery implementation.
Shop connect/restore/events use StandardWalletConnection. Explicit selection and remembered wallet restoration never substitute a different wallet.
Only unknown-chain 4902 permits adding the original YNX network; independent readback and silent SDK restore confirm unchanged account and chain.
Cancellation/logout disconnect pending owned SDK connections, preventing late chain prompts or adoption; failed attempts remove only their own listeners.
Offline Shop cache v10 upgrades the previous shell while preserving other products.

controlledChromium.scope: Actual approved SDK, software approval key and in-memory Gateway fixtures on registered HTTPS origins. Covers original checkout/recovery, canonical Buyer and Seller callback namespaces, private unavailable, AI invalidation and small-screen layouts.
controlledChromium.runBeforeFinalChange: Browser run used final standard connection/discovery source; subsequent changes only updated static unit expectations, added remembered-choice unit guard and bumped SW v9 to v10. Browser configuration blocks SW; cache upgrade verified separately by final unit tests.

verification.initialFailure: Preserved initial unit log: old static test required eth_requestAccounts and EIP6963 implementation literals in product source. Those now belong to the approved SDK; behavior guards still validate account grants and discovery conflict exclusion.
